answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by tying identities to optical surface profilometry of mineral tokens. A verifier commands an agent to lower a motorized quill over a cleaved shale disc, reflecting a laser off an internal mirror to verify unique micro-fractures. An attacker must maintain discrete physical scanning hardware per identity rather than multiplexing virtual nodes. However, thermal expansion can warp the mineral substrate, causing valid agents to fail authentication.
